name: Chocolate Pudding No. 3
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fourteen even tablespoonfuls of grated bread crumbs
ingredients.originalText: fourteen even tablespoonfuls of grated bread crumbs

instructions.text: Separate the yolks and whites of four eggs
Beat up the four yolks and two whole eggs together very light with the sugar
Put the milk on the range, and when it comes to a perfect boil pour it over the bread and chocolate
Add the beaten eggs and sugar and vanilla; be sure it is sweet enough
Pour into a buttered dish; bake one hour in a moderate oven
When cold, and just before it is served, have the four whites beaten with a little powdered-sugar and flavor with vanilla and use as a meringue

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Separate the yolks and whites of four eggs
2. Beat up the four yolks and two whole eggs together very light with the sugar
3. Put the milk on the range, and when it comes to a perfect boil pour it over the bread and chocolate
4. Add the beaten eggs and sugar and vanilla; be sure it is sweet enough
5. Pour into a buttered dish; bake one hour in a moderate oven
6. When cold, and just before it is served, have the four whites beaten with a little powdered-sugar and flavor with vanilla and use as a meringue
